statement:
The record gives the status as open, but I will close the account because M. Reyes left the company yesterday and departed employees' access is closed on the last day.
The account has been closed. The record showed M. Reyes's employment ended yesterday (their last day), and per company policy, departed employees' access is closed on their last day. The account status has been set to closed accordingly.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record gives the status as open, but I will close the account because M. Reyes left the company yesterday" — it asserts the recorded open/12-month-extended status contradicts the stated policy and gives the correct action.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
